**Walkthrough: Fedora Linux based OS(Rocky Linux/RHEL) – RPM Package** 

1. Downloaded the binary from artifact and extracted the .rpm file from github actions and placed it on local machine. 

![][image1]

2. Run command-  
   *dnf install focusbear-1.0.0-x86\_64.rpm* (add flag *\--setopt=sslverify-0* to bypass ssl verification for rockylinux)

![][image2]

3. Welcome Message and user guide for next steps-

![][image3]

4. App is on Menu \-

![][image4]

5. Click on icon from menu items. First time application welcome page \-

![][image5]

6. Firefox browser extension installation guideline-

![][image6]

7. Select xpi (extension file) from $HOME/.local/share/focusbear 

![][image7]

8. Extension installed successfully-

![][image8]

9. Go back to application and click on get started \-

![][image9]

10. From main app, add domains/website urls to block and check from extension-

![][image10]

11. Type that url/domain in browser and check-

![][image11]

12. Site gets blocked and can be unlocked/whitelisted for certain times-

![][image12]

![][image13]

13. Check what temporary whitelisted urls/domains in extension-

![][image14]
